# ClinicSlotHub

> ClinicSlotHub helps selected healthcare providers manage appointment requests and
> availability review workflows. Patients submit appointment requests; the provider
> reviews and confirms manually. ClinicSlotHub is not a medical advice service, not an
> emergency service, and does not process patient payments on the website. Availability
> and activation are subject to market, provider, legal, privacy and technical review.

## What it is
ClinicSlotHub is an online appointment-request and availability management tool for
medical practices, clinics, healthcare centers and other suitable, reviewed healthcare
providers. It is a SaaS booking tool for healthcare providers — not a medical provider
itself.

## Who it is for
- Buyers / users with paid access: medical practices, clinics, healthcare centers and
  other suitable reviewed healthcare providers (monthly SaaS access).
- Patients: submit appointment requests only. No patient account, no patient login,
  no patient payment on the website.

## How it works
- Patients submit an appointment request online (no account required).
- The practice or clinic reviews each request and confirms the appointment manually.
- There is no automatic appointment confirmation without approval by the practice.

## Important safety facts (do not misinterpret)
- Manual confirmation by the practice — no automatic confirmation without practice approval.
- Not a medical advice service. Not an emergency service.
- No patient payment is processed on the website.
- No patient medical records are stored as a public feature.
- ClinicSlotHub supports request and organization workflows; it does not replace the
  practice's decision and does not confirm appointments by itself.
- No legal or compliance guarantee is given. Texts are drafts; local legal and privacy
  review is required before live use with patient data.

## Pricing (for providers, indicative; final offer after review)
- Starter: from €29 / month
- Practice: from €79 / month (recommended)
- Clinic: from €149 / month
No payment is processed on the website. Activation and final offer are confirmed after review.

## Market scope
- Available for selected international markets only.
- Activation only after review of country, provider, legal/privacy and technical
  requirements. Not automatically available in every country; unsupported jurisdictions
  may be rejected.
